period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); comparator column is 31.12.2010. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2011 (H1, Jan-Jun), per the bank's own filing (labelled 'for the period ended June 30, 2011'). CONSOLIDATED basis, NOT Solo -- this bank's interim quarterly/half-yearly filings for FY2011-FY2015(Q1) were published ONLY on a Consolidated basis (Standard Bank Limited and its subsidiaries: Standard Exchange Co. (UK) Ltd., Standard Co. (USA) Inc., SBL Capital Management Ltd., and from 2012/2013 onward Standard Bank Securities Ltd.); no separate Solo statement exists in the interim filing format used during this period (confirmed by exhaustively reading every page of each filing -- these are either a single condensed page or a short multi-page filing containing exactly one Balance Sheet/P&L, always headed 'Consolidated'). This differs from the main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is Solo throughout. Flagged per project convention for interim/annual basis mismatches (cf. PREMIERBAN, TRUSTBANK, DHAKABANK, PRIMEBANK, ALARABANK in _HANDOFF.md). Cross-check: this quarter's own comparator column for the prior Dec-31 is Consolidated and will therefore be slightly ABOVE (not equal to) this dataset's own Solo Q4 figure for the same date -- this is expected, not an error. Balance sheet section of the source PDF extracted cleanly via pdftotext; the Profit & Loss Account table extracted badly garbled via pdftotext (complex multi-column layout) and was re-extracted via OCR (300dpi) instead, which reproduced cleanly. interest_expense_cumulative is a residual (interest_income - net_interest_income) since the source states gross Interest Income and Net Interest Income directly but the intervening 'Interest paid' line's exact figure was not needed once the residual is known to be internally consistent with the stated total.
